name: kith-desktop
description: Desktop shell for Kith — owns the window, the tray, and the app lifecycle.
//: Deliberately NOT "type": "module". Electron's main process and any sandboxed preload must be CommonJS; declaring ESM here silently breaks a sandboxed preload if one is ever added.

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Kith needs this to read files you point him at on your Desktop.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Kith needs this to read files you point him at in Documents.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Kith needs this to read files you point him at in Downloads.
